rows.note: Use 抵 as the everyday all-purpose way to say that something is worth what it costs.

example.english: These movie tickets are so cheap and the movie is so good; they’re really cost-effective.
example.traditional: 呢張戲飛咁平，套戲又咁正，真係抵。
example.jyutping: ne1 zoeng1 hei3 fei1 gam3 peng4 tou3 hei3 jau6 gam3 zeng3 zan1 hai6 dai2

rows.note: Choose 化算 when stressing that an option or investment is economically worthwhile.

example.english: Buying the family-sized pack is much more cost-effective than buying them one by one.
example.traditional: 買家庭裝比逐支買化算好多。
example.jyutping: maai5 gaa1 ting4 zong1 bei2 zuk6 zi1 maai5 faa3 syun3 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use 性價比高 when explicitly comparing performance or benefits with price, especially across products or plans.

example.english: This phone has lots of features and is not expensive, so it is cost-effective.
example.traditional: 呢部手機功能多又唔貴，性價比高。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 sau2 gei1 gung1 nang4 do1 jau6 m4 gwai3 sing3 gaa3 bei2 gou1
